_comment: BIXI Montreal. Three trip layouts and three station layouts, verified across every acquired file by pipeline/census.py. Extraction FAILS on any header not listed here, so new drift becomes an explicit decision rather than a silent guess. Note what the 2022 break costs: is_member and the integer station key both disappear, and are not recoverable.

_eras.2021: station key renamed AND renumbered to emplacement_pk (a different key space, joining to GBFS station_id rather than short_name); millisecond timestamps
_eras.2022+: one unsorted annual CSV; epoch-millisecond timestamps; station NAME only, with coordinates inline; membership gone
